name: Yonabaru (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yonabaru town emblem in navy: a stylised bird-like device with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Yonabaru, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1973.

features.role: Yonabaru town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a ring
